user_optical_feedback: Current final diagnostic firmware: switching normal, no obvious anomalies, 2026-10-26; not an instrumented optical/ghosting measurement

real_file_faults_host: epoch full proof then close and same-epoch reopen
software_validation.visible_simulator: Rebuilt and restarted with final source, original demo fixtures; not a physical panel measurement

limitations: Device faults use read-side diagnostic injection; host tests delete and tamper actual cache files. Neither proves TF electrical faults or FAT power-cut atomicity.
Reboot-first opens and NEXT values are listed separately; no matched cold-reboot baseline was collected in this batch.

Immediate NEXT control alternates hit/miss twice per book in the same candidate image using read-side missing injection (hit, miss, hit, miss); this isolates startup-cache read policy, not a flashed f461862 baseline. Paired old/new first NEXT uses the identical 15-second protocol.
Still two display jobs (loading plus body) on these books; no claim that loading is removed.
No whole-flash host backup; preserved formal ota_1 and seq2 VALID. No bootloader, NVS or assets written.
Diagnostic console disables true locking sleep; prior sleep cold-reopen problem and power/optical acceptance remain separate.
Pool peaks are entire unequal-length sessions, not paired peak reductions. No limits or image precision increased.
No formal firmware release; device keeps final 1.0.6-diag.
